caption:
Worried about provision? Read this

Allah tells us there is no moving creature on earth but its provision is upon Him, and that He knows its place of dwelling and its place of rest. Do your work today, and leave the worry of provision with the One who provides.

Surah Hud 11:6

Which worry about provision will you hand back to Allah today?

#rizq #provision #tawakkul #quranreels

Recitation: Abdul Basit Abdus-Samad
